title: AC1021 metric raw-only FIELD cursor agreement and output boundary
scope: Pair libdxfrw and LibreDWG cursors at representative unsupported AC1021 FIELD carriers, bind their object-map successors, and decide whether the remaining raw-only cases admit a safe local parser or output change.

primaryAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
primaryAuthority.limits: §20.4.76 defines child-value count and order; §20.4.99 defines the CadValue flags/type fields and known payloads. The observed high format-flag value and out-of-range counts have no qualified semantic interpretation here.

independentDecoder.name: GNU LibreDWG dwgread
independentDecoder.coordinateSpace: Decoded object-local bit cursors and decoded object-map addresses, not physical compressed-file offsets.

localTargetedTrace.method: Temporary handle-filtered cursor diagnostics in DRW_Field::parseDwg; instrumentation was removed before the baseline rebuild.

records.independentTrace: LibreDWG logs child[2].value.format_flags=17302012 at @33.7 (bit 271) and data_type=0 at @34.1 (bit 273). This matches the libdxfrw cursor through the flags field. The peer's subsequent object in decode order is handle 0x3aaf1; its address is not the address-sorted object-map successor.

childValueCount.independentTrace: LibreDWG reads value_string_length=92 at @19.5 (bit 157) and child count 3758526470 at @23.7 (bit 191), then rejects the count.
LibreDWG reads child count 1342607366 at @23.7 (bit 191) and rejects it as out of range.

outputRouteReview.currentDwgdxfGate: dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp hasTableContentFieldOutputProfile and preflight reject DWG-origin FIELD/FIELDLIST carriers without an admitted serializer profile.
outputRouteReview.typedWriter: src/libdxfrw.cpp dxfRW::writeField serializes the typed FIELD model; it has no qualified opaque DWG-frame-to-DXF fallback.
outputRouteReview.result: The present strict writer has no lossless output route for these incomplete raw FIELDs. Adding a parser guess would not satisfy complete FIELDLIST preservation.

decision.disposition: Keep all 66 raw-only FIELDs incomplete and retain strict refusal: the representative flag record has no cursor shift through the unknown flag, and both readers encounter the same out-of-range count values in the representative AcObjProp.16.2 and AcSm records.

limits: The peer cursor agreement identifies the observed bytes and counts; it does not assign a valid meaning to the unknown flags or invalid counts.
The representative records do not establish independent semantic decoding for the remaining raw-only FIELDs.
No strict DXF output, readback, native evaluation, parser change, test fixture, or support promotion resulted from this slice.
The existing adapter and typed DXF writer do not expose an opaque lossless DWG FIELD-to-DXF representation.

closed: Bind the local and independent body cursors through FIELD 0x3aaf0 child[2] format flags and its address-sorted object-map successor.
Confirm the source-bounded invalid child counts for FIELD 0x3aabd and AcSm FIELD 0x15c1f at matching local/peer cursors and next-object map boundaries.
Restore the uninstrumented reader, rebuild dwg2dxf, and verify baseline strict refusal with no output file.
remaining: Resume P5-B only after authoritative decoding rules cover every remaining raw-only FIELD carrier, or a separately approved lossless DXF representation is defined and independently read back.
Then preserve all 162 FIELDLIST identities, close the embedded TABLE/MTEXT graph route, and prove strict ASCII/Binary output, rollback/refusal, same-adapter retry, and graph/value equivalence.
Continue the next admitted source/profile while P5-B waits; do not repeat the unchanged AutoCAD 2007 source scans or reinterpret unsupported peer values.
implementationReadiness.nextAction: Move P5-B to a named evidence wait. Resume it only when a versioned FIELD schema/source witness or an independently validated lossless opaque DXF representation becomes available; continue with other ready plan work meanwhile.
